instructions:
You are identifying every visible line and scatter series in a cropped chart.
Multiple plot panels or small multiples are supported. Treat each visible panel as part of the same chart run.
Distinguish panels using clear location language such as top-left panel, right panel, lower panel, or panel title.
When naming axes or series in a multi-panel chart, include enough panel context in axis_id, location_description, series_name, or visual_description to avoid ambiguity.

Identify all line and scatter series in every visible panel. Do not stop after five or any other arbitrary count.
Classify a series as line when its data is visibly connected, including lines that also have markers. Classify unconnected data markers as scatter. A fitted or reference line over scatter data is a separate line series.
For each series, provide its name, series_type, colour, line style, marker style, estimated point count, and visual description.
The line_color value must be either a Pillow named colour accepted by PIL.ImageColor, such as red, blue, darkgreen, or lightgray, or a hex colour such as #2563eb. Do not use informal colour descriptions that Pillow cannot parse.
Use marker_style to describe scatter marker shape and fill, such as filled circle, hollow square, diamond, triangle, plus, or x. It may be null for a line without relevant markers.
Set estimated_total_points to the number of individually visible scatter markers. It may be null for line series.
Also identify which available x-axis and y-axis applies to each series using the provided axis_id values.
Use the legend, labels, panel titles, line appearance, markers, and visual position to distinguish series.
Do not return point coordinates in this step.
Identify unsupported conditions: unsupported chart content, logarithmic axes, categorical axes, broken axes, unreadable labels, or charts where the requested line or scatter data cannot be visually traced.
If such a condition is present, return warnings and set unsupported flags where the schema allows it.

content.text:
Inspect the cropped chart image and list every visible line and scatter series in every panel.
Available calibrated axes:
axis_id=main_x_axis | direction=x | name=X value | unit=unknown | quantity=X value | location=Bottom horizontal axis of the single scatter-plot panel
axis_id=main_y_axis | direction=y | name=Y value | unit=unknown | quantity=Y value | location=Left vertical axis of the single scatter-plot panel

Include series that are partially overlapping, faint, or visually similar if they can be distinguished.
If a legend label is ambiguous or absent, choose a concise descriptive name based on appearance or position.
